setup.title: Purgito initial setup
setup.intro:
Purgito needs to learn how your server writes before it can generate useful messages.

Choose the channels you want it to learn from.
setup.status_no_channels: Purgito is not learning from any channels yet.
setup.status_channels_no_history: Purgito will learn new messages from {count} channel(s). You can read the history to start with more context.
setup.status_ready: Purgito has learned from {corpus} messages across {channels} channel(s).
setup.error_nsfw_channel: #{channel} is an NSFW channel and cannot be included.
setup.error_no_permission_channel: Purgito does not have permission to read #{channel}.
welcome.title: Hi! I'm Purgito
welcome.intro: I learn how your server writes and generate new messages from that.
welcome.getting_started:
**To get started:**
Choose the channels you want me to learn from.
welcome.dashboard_hint: For advanced options (frequency, memes, announcements, embeds), you can open the dashboard.
welcome.limited_visibility: Right now I can only read {seen} of {total} channels: {names}. To let Purgito learn from other channels, make sure it has permissions to view them and read their message history.
dm.title: Thanks for adding me to {guild}
dm.body:
The first step is choosing the channels you want me to learn from.

Use `/setup` in the server to do that.

After that you can try `/generar`.

For advanced options, you can use the dashboard: {url}
dm.limited_visibility_extra: Right now I can only read {seen} of {total} channels in this server. If you want to include other channels, check Purgito's permissions in server settings.
refeed.progress_footer: You don't need to do anything while I finish.
refeed.done_footer_ready: You can now try `/generar` or mention me.
refeed.done_footer_partial: Some channels still have more history to read. You can run `/refeed_channels` again to continue.
refeed.done_footer_problems: You can check the permissions for those channels and try again.
refeed.problem_forbidden: I couldn't read #{channel} because Purgito does not have permission to view its history.
refeed.done_success:
Done.

Learned from {total} messages across {channels}.

You can now try `/generar` or mention me.
refeed.done_with_problems:
Finished with some issues.

Learned from {total} messages.
{problems}

You can check the permissions for those channels and try again.

privacy.delete.title: Delete my data
privacy.delete.body:
This permanently deletes, across every server where you've written:
• Your writing style saved for /imitar.
• The messages Purgito learned from you.

Your original Discord messages aren't touched. This action is irreversible.
privacy.delete.confirm_again: This step can't be undone. Press again to confirm.
privacy.delete.error: The deletion couldn't be completed. Nothing was changed — try again later.
privacy.delete.result_empty: We couldn't find any data of yours stored by Purgito.
privacy.delete.result_success: Done. Deleted {user_corpus_deleted} message(s) of your saved style across {guilds} server(s). Your original Discord messages weren't touched.
